title: WNBA PRA Speed V3 Step 9 — Final strict production speed certification
scope: Certification-only final gate. Compose the frozen Step-5 production true-cold/warm profile with the frozen Step-8 cached-cold/visible-first profile and fail closed unless every final speed budget passes. Step 9 adds no product/runtime/model/provider/router/math behavior.

proof_contract.true_cold_source: frozen Step-5 production profile fresh browser/session traversal
proof_contract.warm_same_session_source: frozen Step-5 production profile zero-read warm reopen
proof_contract.cached_cold_source: frozen Step-8 production profile after frozen Step-7 precompute readiness

evidence: The Step-9 certifier emitted WNBA_PRA_SPEED_V3_STEP9_ROUTE_PRIME_GREEN and used the WNBA/PRA query URL.
The live body still remained on MLB Live Odds / Run Line for the full 600-second Step-5 deployment window.
No true-cold, warm, cached-cold, or visible-continuity timing was measured before failure.
production_failure.root_cause: The production Streamlit session ignored/canonicalized the query handoff and retained stale MLB route state. Query priming alone is therefore insufficient proof of route acquisition.
production_failure.patch: Verifier-only: after the query hint, select the exact visible 🏟️ Sport control to WNBA and the exact 🎯 WNBA Market control to PRA by accessible labels/options, then require the frozen WNBA PRA slate contract before timing. Preserve all product code and speed budgets.

evidence: Step-9 production reached the frozen Step-5 profiler but never reached any speed measurement.
The live browser body remained on MLB Live Odds / Run Line while Step-5 waited for the WNBA PRA marker for 600 seconds.
The API fast-history route was deployed GREEN, proving this was not an API deployment failure.
production_failure_history.root_cause: The reused frozen navigation helper tried to switch sport/market through positional comboboxes from a stale MLB-loaded Streamlit session. Streamlit reruns can canonicalize the URL to root, so reload-based verifier retries can lose the intended WNBA/PRA route.
production_failure_history.patch: Step-9 certifier only: enter the existing certified ?ks_jump_sport=WNBA&ks_jump_market=PRA query handoff and re-prime that immutable route before each frozen Step-5/Step-8 route check. Do not modify frozen product/runtime code or any speed budget.

evidence: Frozen navigation helper CERTIFIED_GAME_DATES contains only 2026-08-27, 2026-08-23, 2026-09-18, 2026-09-27, and 2026-09-29.
Current date is 2026-10-01 and official WNBA postseason games remain scheduled on/after 2026-10-01.
Frozen Step-5 game selection imports and reuses the stale CERTIFIED_GAME_DATES fallback.
Step-8 delegates game selection to frozen Step-5, so the same stale fallback can affect final certification.
upcoming_game_repair.root_cause: Step-9 composes frozen Step-5/Step-8 production verifiers whose fallback game-date list is historical. When the default slate cannot supply a usable two-player game, final certification can traverse already-completed WNBA games.
upcoming_game_repair.patch: Step-9 verifier only: discover dates from the live Kyre/WNBA schedule from today forward; require status=scheduled, verification.playable_pregame=true, and for today's slate a future UTC start. Temporarily override the frozen date fallback only for the Step-9 certification process, then restore it.

stale_base_forward_port.recovery_rule: Forward-port the same verifier-only upcoming-game repair onto current main and obtain one fresh exact-head proof before merge.
